title: This section's polynomial-inverse error is strictly below 2^{-76} (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, the degree-13 Taylor sum of `exp(361)` equals `917160294948960776428552987246843/3113510400`, which is strictly greater than `2^{76}*(319/100) = 6025739632141667292676096/25`.
- The degree-12 partial sum is strictly below that target, and the next Taylor term is positive, so `(319/100) exp(-361) < 2^{-76}`. This section's polynomial-inverse error is strictly below that majorant, hence strictly below `2^{-76}`.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is the case `C=4` on one normalized section, and `Q` is not formed.
- The parent commits are #4367 and #4368. This pull request adds `research/gaussian-origin-two-power-c4` and replays those predecessors.
